verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the developer MCP's ability to "promote versions from chat", which covers app versions rather than automation recipes, plus admin auditing of every agent action, a form of after-the-fact review. Nothing shows automation-level versioning, change review, or rollback. Missing for 10: versioning of automations themselves, a review/diff workflow for automation changes, rollback to prior automation versions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
